runtime.provenance: Official Uiua ARM64 macOS release binary; not a locally compiled substitute.
runtime.system_library_policy: macOS platform libraries are supplied by the recorded host OS; no additional non-system runtime dylib is linked by Uiua.

publication_record.timing_boundary: Fresh full process from immediately before launch through process exit; Uiua source compilation inside run is included. External preparation/builds, output validation and hashing are excluded.
publication_record.provenance: Locally authored additive general-array denominator rewrite of canonical Uiua v2; original and canonical sources and evidence preserved.
adaptations: Canonical constants, momentum offset, binary64 pair forces, dt=0.01, all requested updates and two fixed nine-decimal energies; optimized computes NewVelocity once per step and retains that value for position/state assembly.
Use exact canonical Jupiter z initial coordinate -0.103622044471123109.
Move cube/square root outside nested Rows; apply only native depth-aware Fix. Norm and every other source byte remain unchanged.
